players.product: high-speed DRAM / NAND memory wafer testers

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 IR book: YC describes itself as the domestic market-share leader in DRAM and NAND memory wafer testers, competing in Korea with Japanese company A and US company T, and claims product performance equal to its foreign rivals with better price competitiveness: an MTBF of 16,000 hours against 8,000 hours (twice the competitor's), manufacturing turnaround of 2 months against 4 months, and new-product development in 1.5 years against 3 years. It cites in-house core technology in high-capacity high-speed fail memory, high-speed repair analysis, FPGA-based timing and pattern generators with its own ASIC, and signal and power delivery design; affiliate SEMCNS supplies STF (space transformer) ceramic substrates for probe cards
quarterly_data.figure: MTBF 16,000 hours (competitor 8,000); manufacturing TAT 2 months (competitor 4); development 1.5 years (competitor 3)
